FN-MSKZTHW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 230
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/03/2026
Senate Bill 230 as introduced would authorize candidates and elected officials to use campaign
contributions to pay for certain security expenses provided to themselves, their immediate
family members and staff. This could reduce expenditures paid from the State General Fund by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the extent to which elected officials incur costs for the
security expenses provided by this bill and use campaign contributions to reimburse the state for
reasonable costs incurred, as provided by this bill.
